kich_ban: Not the ones that arrive after long prayer and finally make us cry. Every good thing in our lives came down from you, including the ones so constant that we stopped registering them as gifts at all. This is our real request this morning, and it is the one we came for.

y_chinh: The central request is for opened eyes
tu_khoa: sunlit valley details,morning meadow light,foothill landscape wide
hinh_can_tim: A sunlit valley reveals grass, trees and distant hills in layered depth as the camera moves slowly forward.
tranh: people, buildings, midday glare, sunset, fast camera
kich_ban: Open our eyes. Not to something new. To what is already here. Let us hear it right now, before we go anywhere. Somewhere in this house there is the sound of another person moving. We are not alone in the world.

y_chinh: Breath shelter and connection are noticed as gifts
tu_khoa: birds valley morning,path through meadow dawn,foothill wildlife
hinh_can_tim: Small birds move calmly above a meadow path while the foothills remain visible in the distance.
tranh: bird swarm, hunting, houses, sunset, fast motion
kich_ban: Our body is breathing without being told to, and it has done that our whole lives without a single instruction from us. There is a key in our pocket, and a door somewhere that opens for us. There is a name in our phone we could call at a bad hour and they would answer.

y_chinh: Long-prayed-for companionship is seen with gratitude
tu_khoa: paired birds meadow,distant companionship nature,morning grass wildlife
hinh_can_tim: A pair of birds rests among sunlit meadow grass, small within the wider landscape.
tranh: human faces, romantic acting, nest close-up, sunset, wildlife drama
kich_ban: There is food in the kitchen that we did not worry about yesterday. There is a pair of shoes that fit us, and somewhere to be today. Some of us are praying beside someone we once begged you for. We asked for them for years. They are here, in the next room, and we have not thanked you for them in months.

y_chinh: What looked like background is recognized as the story
tu_khoa: river valley aerial,sunlit watershed drone,meadow river wide
hinh_can_tim: A slow aerial reveals the river, meadow and foothills as one continuous living landscape.
tranh: fast drone, tourism spectacle, city, sunset, harsh midday
kich_ban: We have been treating all of that as the background. As the setting the story happens in. It is not the setting, Father. It is the story. It is you, providing, continuously, in a way so steady that it became invisible.

y_chinh: Blessing is rediscovered in what is already present
tu_khoa: wildflowers meadow edge,bees field morning,flowers sunlight breeze
hinh_can_tim: Wildflowers and a few bees move gently at the meadow edge in warm natural light.
tranh: insect swarm, artificial garden, people, sunset, oversaturated grade
kich_ban: And forgive us for what we have made the word blessing mean. We have made it mean the thing we do not have yet. The answer that is still coming. We have been standing in the middle of an answered prayer we prayed five years ago, complaining about a different one.

y_chinh: The prayer asks for sight rather than more possessions
tu_khoa: butterfly meadow morning,dew grass sunlight,valley detail warm
hinh_can_tim: A butterfly settles among dew-lit grass while the wider valley remains softly visible.
tranh: money imagery, luxury, artificial macro, sunset, people
kich_ban: We are not asking for more this morning. We are asking for sight. Give us eyes for what is already here. Let us walk through this ordinary day and keep catching ourselves noticing, not because any of it is impressive, but because all of it is yours.

y_chinh: Seen blessings begin to flow outward toward others
tu_khoa: open valley aerial,countryside morning drone,widening landscape sunlight
hinh_can_tim: The landscape widens into open countryside as a slow aerial expands beyond the personal journey.
tranh: fast drone, city, storm, sunset, tourism spectacle
kich_ban: And when we start seeing it, do not let us hold it. Because we are not the only ones in this house, on this street, or in this hour who need something from you.

y_chinh: Prayer reaches someone unable to find gratitude
tu_khoa: distant silhouette valley,misty foothills morning,quiet trail wide
hinh_can_tim: A very small distant silhouette pauses on a misty foothill trail as a narrow area of light appears ahead.
tranh: face, crying, acting, dark night, sunset
kich_ban: Somewhere this morning, someone is awake and cannot find one single thing to be thankful for. They are not being difficult. They have looked. Father, we are praying for them now.

y_chinh: One believable crack of light reaches pressure
tu_khoa: sun ray foothills,mist opening valley,clouds clearing mountain morning
hinh_can_tim: A single soft ray breaks through thinning cloud and reaches a quiet foothill valley.
tranh: supernatural beam, storm, harsh flare, sunset, people
kich_ban: Not that their situation would suddenly reverse, but that before this day is over you would give them one thing. One. Small enough to be believable. A stranger who is kind for no reason. A few minutes where the pressure lifts. Something ordinary that lands like it was placed there on purpose.

y_chinh: Long waiting continues along an unfinished path
tu_khoa: winding foothill trail,valley path aerial,mountain morning road
hinh_can_tim: A slow aerial follows a winding foothill trail whose end remains beyond the frame.
tranh: fast drone, paved highway, sunset, dramatic cliffs, tourism spectacle
kich_ban: Give them a single crack of light, and give them the ability to see it when it comes, because the seeing is the harder half. We know. We were there. And Father, we bring you the ones who have been waiting a long time.

y_chinh: Unanswered prayer is held without slogans
tu_khoa: foggy mountain trail,mist valley path,quiet foothills dawn
hinh_can_tim: A quiet trail continues through light valley mist, with no dramatic reveal or forced resolution.
tranh: heavy fog, danger, lost hiker acting, sunset, dark night
kich_ban: They have prayed the same prayer so many times that the words have gone flat in their mouth. The answer has not come, and worse, no explanation has come either. We are not going to pretend to know your timing, and we are not going to hand them a slogan this morning.

y_chinh: Gratitude becomes possible while the answer is still forming
tu_khoa: sunlight reaching trail,foothill path morning,valley mist clearing
hinh_can_tim: Warm light reaches part of the trail while the farther path remains gently veiled.
tranh: instant transformation, harsh flare, sunset, people, timelapse
kich_ban: But we ask you for something specific for them. Give them the ability to be thankful while they are still waiting, which is the hardest gratitude there is. Not thankful for the delay. Thankful in it. Let them find you good before they find you finished.

y_chinh: Grief and gratitude are allowed to share one hour
tu_khoa: steady tree morning,light shade meadow,valley tree wide
hinh_can_tim: A steady tree holds both cool shade and warm morning light within a wide quiet valley.
tranh: crying close-up, cemetery, acting, dark mood, sunset
kich_ban: There is another group, and we hold them gently. Some who hear this have lost someone. And a strange guilt has attached itself to them, because there are moments in the day when they laugh, or enjoy the sun, or forget for an hour, and then it feels like a betrayal.

y_chinh: God's nearness holds the brokenhearted without pressure
tu_khoa: gentle stream under tree,riverbank shade morning,water roots sunlight
hinh_can_tim: A gentle stream passes beneath tree roots as warm light and cool shade remain together.
tranh: faces, dramatic grief, flood, sunset, supernatural effects
kich_ban: Father, tell them it is not. Gratitude is not disloyalty to grief. They can hold both. You are near to the brokenhearted, and you are not standing over them waiting for them to cheer up. Sit with them this morning. Let them weep and let them be thankful in the same hour, and let neither one cancel the other.

y_chinh: Caregivers are carried in their unseen labor
tu_khoa: two distant walkers trail,back view valley path,figures foothills morning
hinh_can_tim: Two small back-view figures move slowly along a foothill path, surrounded by the larger landscape.
tranh: faces, hospital acting, dramatic exhaustion, sunset, branded clothing
kich_ban: And there are the ones who are keeping someone else alive this morning. A parent. A husband. A daughter who moved back home. They get up before they are ready, every day, and nobody claps. Father, they have been giving from a place that has nothing left in it. Carry the part of it they cannot carry.

y_chinh: Familiar people at home become visible again
tu_khoa: nesting birds morning,birds meadow family,quiet valley wildlife
hinh_can_tim: Small birds tend a simple nest at the edge of a meadow while the scene remains calm and wide.
tranh: chicks close-up, feeding frenzy, human home, sunset, wildlife drama
kich_ban: And let somebody thank them today in a way they can actually hear. And last, our own homes. The people we live with have become the most familiar thing in our lives, which is exactly why we stopped seeing them. Forgive us. Let gratitude be spoken out loud in our houses today, not only felt.

y_chinh: Spoken gratitude creates warmth within the home
tu_khoa: sunlit meadow wide,clustered trees morning,valley golden landscape
hinh_can_tim: Warm light spreads across a meadow and a small cluster of trees, creating a quiet sense of belonging.
tranh: faces, lifestyle acting, house interior, sunset, advertising
kich_ban: Let us tell one person specifically what we are glad for about them, and not in general terms. Make our home a place where good things get named instead of assumed. And now, Father, bring all of this back to us. Because everything we have just asked for other people is something we have to choose for ourselves first.

y_chinh: Personal faith begins by counting what was received
tu_khoa: foothill trail beginning,path through grass morning,golden trail detail
hinh_can_tim: A foothill trail begins in the foreground and moves toward warmer open light.
tranh: face, running, branded shoes, dramatic climb, sunset
kich_ban: I want to stop saying we for a moment, and speak only for myself. I choose to count what I have been given before I count what I am missing. That list was there when I woke up. It is still there. Nothing on it has been solved while we have been praying.

y_chinh: The first hour belongs to received grace rather than lack
tu_khoa: wide hill path morning,valley trail aerial,golden foothills wide
hinh_can_tim: A wide path opens across gentle foothills as the camera rises and reveals more of the route.
tranh: fast drone, dramatic summit, sunset, tourism spectacle, people
kich_ban: But it is no longer the first thing I see, and I am not handing it the first hour of my day again. I choose to walk into today as someone who has already received more than I asked for, rather than someone still waiting to be paid.

y_chinh: Gratitude remains steady even if circumstances do not change
tu_khoa: steady tree hill morning,wind tree foothills,warm valley landscape
hinh_can_tim: A mature tree stands steady in a light breeze above the valley under a warm morning sky.
tranh: storm, dead tree, sunset, dramatic wind, people
kich_ban: And I will thank you today even if today changes nothing. That is the harder one. If the phone does not ring. If the answer does not come.

y_chinh: Mercy remains new when the expected answer does not come
tu_khoa: warm river valley,river sunlight aerial,morning water hills
hinh_can_tim: The river continues through the warm valley beneath slowly drifting clouds, unchanged but fully illuminated.
tranh: storm, sunset, fast drone, city, harsh midday
kich_ban: If this evening looks exactly like last evening and the thing I have been carrying is still sitting there at the end of it, I will still say that your mercy was new this morning, because it was. My gratitude is not a receipt for services rendered. I am not thankful because the situation improved.

y_chinh: God's character remains settled beyond circumstances
tu_khoa: mountain horizon morning,foothill sky golden,open valley clouds
hinh_can_tim: A stable mountain horizon stands beneath an open golden morning sky with slow cloud movement.
tranh: sunset, dramatic peaks, snow mismatch, people, tourism spectacle
kich_ban: I am thankful because you are who you said you are, and that was settled long before my circumstances got involved. And then there is this, and it is the thing I most want to say.

y_chinh: Mercy grace and blessing lead beyond the gifts themselves
tu_khoa: streams joining valley,river confluence morning,watershed aerial sunlight
hinh_can_tim: Two gentle waterways meet in a broad valley as a slow aerial reveals their shared direction.
tranh: flood, dramatic confluence, fast drone, sunset, industrial structures
kich_ban: Lord, I have spent a long time wanting things from you. Mercy, so I can be clean. Grace, so I can be strong. Blessings, so my life can be full. All of that is good, and you offer all of it freely.

y_chinh: The heart desires God more than what God provides
tu_khoa: small figure toward light,distant walker hill,back view valley morning
hinh_can_tim: A small back-view figure stands facing warm open light from a quiet hillside.
tranh: face, raised arms performance, acting, sunset, dramatic summit
kich_ban: But this morning I want you. More than mercy. More than grace. More than every good thing that comes down from you. I want the One they come from. Not the gifts arriving from your hand. Your face. Because it is entirely possible to love what God provides and slowly stop loving God.

y_chinh: Attachment to provision is released
tu_khoa: hands releasing leaf stream,open hands water morning,riverbank detail
hinh_can_tim: Open hands release a small leaf above moving water, keeping the gesture natural and understated.
tranh: face, jewelry focus, dramatic prayer pose, sunset, reverse footage
kich_ban: I do not want to find out one day that I have been in love with the provision all along. I have prayed to you for years the way I would text someone I only contact when I need something. I am not proud of that. I do not know how to fix it in one morning.

y_chinh: Wanting God begins as an honest upward step
tu_khoa: uphill trail morning,foothill path sunlight,walking trail wide
hinh_can_tim: A quiet uphill trail leads through soft grass toward an open band of morning light.
tranh: hiker face, strenuous climb, sunset, cliff danger, tourism spectacle
kich_ban: But I want to want you, and I am saying it plainly, in case wanting to want you is where it starts. If I had everything I have prayed for and did not have you, I would have nothing.

y_chinh: God is enough and the whole ordinary day is offered
tu_khoa: hilltop valley aerial,golden watershed wide,morning foothills drone
hinh_can_tim: A slow aerial rises above gentle foothills to reveal the entire river valley in warm morning light.
tranh: fast drone, dramatic mountain, sunset, tourism spectacle, people
kich_ban: If I have you and nothing else ever changes, I have enough. And I can only say any of this because you chose me first, on a morning when I was not looking for you at all. So take this day. It is not much, and it is not particularly impressive, but it is all of it. I choose you.

y_chinh: The listener quietly chooses God through the whole day
tu_khoa: golden trail forward,foothill path morning,open valley road
hinh_can_tim: The golden trail continues steadily toward open space, calm and purposeful without a visible performer.
tranh: face, running, victory pose, sunset, branded clothing
kich_ban: This morning, and at eleven o'clock when it is harder, and tonight when nobody is watching. I choose you.

y_chinh: The central promise returns as the journey reaches the sea
tu_khoa: ocean sunrise horizon,golden coast morning,sea sun wide
hinh_can_tim: The visible morning sun rests above the ocean horizon as the coastal world returns in warm light.
tranh: sunset, midday, blown highlights, people, harsh flare
kich_ban: Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness. That was true before we prayed. It will still be true tomorrow, when we have forgotten it again.

y_chinh: Truth carried from the prayer flows back toward open water
tu_khoa: estuary to ocean aerial,river mouth golden,coast watershed drone
hinh_can_tim: A slow aerial follows the river mouth toward the open sea, joining the inland journey to the coast.
tranh: fast drone, industrial port, sunset, boats with logos, tourism spectacle
kich_ban: The list is still there. We are not pretending otherwise. But we picked up something else first this morning, and we are carrying that out the door with us. That we were held through a night we did not manage. That we were met with mercy we had already used many times.

y_chinh: Changed sight recognizes mercy grace and surrounding gifts
tu_khoa: shoreline reflection morning,golden waves wet sand,coast detail sunlight
hinh_can_tim: Warm reflections move across wet sand and shallow waves, revealing ordinary coastal details with new clarity.
tranh: sunset, crowds, harsh glare, fast waves, commercial beach
kich_ban: That grace will arrive at exactly the size of the next step. And that we have been surrounded the whole time by good things we had stopped seeing. Nothing in our circumstances has changed in the last half hour. Something in our eyes has.

y_chinh: The listener walks forward as someone who has received
tu_khoa: seabirds golden coast,birds ocean morning,shoreline wide sunrise
hinh_can_tim: Seabirds fly calmly across a broad golden coastline as the horizon remains open and peaceful.
tranh: bird swarm, feeding frenzy, sunset, crowds, fast motion
kich_ban: We will forget this by lunch. That is alright. Forgetting is not failing. We will come back tomorrow and let it be new again, because that is the one thing it is guaranteed to be. We choose to walk into this day as people who have already received, not people still waiting to begin.

y_chinh: The blessing sends the listener into the day
tu_khoa: golden ocean sunrise drone,calm coast hero shot,sea horizon morning
hinh_can_tim: A slow forward drone holds a luminous ocean hero shot, with soft sun and spacious golden water.
tranh: fast drone, sunset, harsh flare, tourism spectacle, boats
kich_ban: Father, send us out. May mercy reach you before the news does today. May grace be enough for you in the exact place you already know you are not enough. And may your eyes keep opening, again and again, to what has been in front of you the whole time.

y_chinh: Mercy and grace open the eyes to what is already present
tu_khoa: sunlit waves wide,calm ocean golden,coastal morning sky
hinh_can_tim: Long gentle waves catch warm light beneath an open morning sky, held with fewer cuts.
tranh: sunset, midday, storm, people, harsh orange
kich_ban: May you become someone who notices, and who says it out loud. May you be hard to discourage, because you have learned to count what is already in your hands. In the name of Jesus we pray. Amen.

y_chinh: Community gratitude is invited without breaking the peace
tu_khoa: coastal pebbles morning,waves sand detail,golden shore close up
hinh_can_tim: Small pebbles and shells sit beside gentle water in warm coastal light while the tide moves softly.
tranh: hands typing, social media graphics, sunset, crowds, product shot
kich_ban: Before you go, one small thing. Type one word in the comments. One thing you are thankful for this morning. Just one word. Then read a few of the others, because someone down there is going to need to borrow yours today.

y_chinh: The prayer is shared with someone who needs light
tu_khoa: two distant walkers beach,shoreline figures morning,coast path wide
hinh_can_tim: Two distant back-view figures walk along the broad shoreline, remaining small beneath the open sky.
tranh: faces, gestures to camera, romantic acting, sunset, crowds
kich_ban: If this helped you start the morning differently, send it to the person you thought of when we prayed for those who could not find anything to be thankful for. Leaving a like helps this prayer reach someone waking up alone with their list.

y_chinh: Gratitude sends the listener beyond the room
tu_khoa: footprints shoreline morning,walking coast golden,shore path sunlight
hinh_can_tim: A short line of footprints continues along the golden shoreline toward open space.
tranh: branded shoes, running, face, sunset, staged footprints
kich_ban: And if you want to keep beginning your days like this, subscribe, and we will meet you here tomorrow. One last thing. Gratitude is not meant to keep us in the room. It sends us out the door.

y_chinh: The next prayer waits beyond the visible horizon
tu_khoa: ocean horizon drone,golden sea forward aerial,calm coast ending
hinh_can_tim: A slow forward aerial moves toward the open ocean horizon and holds the peaceful golden morning through the ending.
tranh: sunset, end screen graphics, fast drone, harsh flare, tourism spectacle
kich_ban: And the day waiting on the other side of that door has things in it we cannot see yet, and cannot carry on our own. That is the next prayer, and it is already on your screen. It will be waiting for you whenever you are ready.
